reports.title: Kulicke & Soffa Reports Fourth Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: K&S currently expects net revenue in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 ending January 2, 2027 to be approximately $410 million +/- $20 million, GAAP diluted EPS to be approximately $1.48 +/- 10%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS to be approximately $1.65 +/- 10%.
A reconciliation between the GAAP and non-GAAP financial outlook is provided in the financial tables included at the end of this press release.

desk.headline: Revenue up 131% to $410.3m, beat; Q1 outlook of $410m ± $20m keeps sales flat with a higher EPS range
results: Quarterly revenue more than doubled to $410.3m (up 131% y/y and 24% on the June quarter), ahead of the $376.8m expected and above the top of its own $395m range.
Adjusted EPS was $1.52 against $0.28 a year ago and about $1.43 expected; GAAP EPS was $1.37.
Gross margin was 47.8% and adjusted operating margin 23.5%, up from 6.6% a year earlier.
Full fiscal 2026 revenue rose 81% to $1.18bn, with adjusted EPS of $3.95; cash flow was weaker, with only $14.6m of adjusted free cash flow in the quarter as receivables and inventory grew.
Quarterly dividend held at 20.5c; buybacks were small ($3.1m in the quarter, $10.4m for the year).

guidance.summary: For the December quarter K&S expects revenue of about $410m ± $20m (flat on Q4) and adjusted EPS of about $1.65 ± 10%. This is a new quarterly range, not a change to an earlier one.

points: New CEO Raj Talluri set three priorities: protect the core wire-bonding business, scale advanced packaging, and focus spending on the best opportunities.
AI and data-centre chips are driving demand: general semiconductor rose to 74% of quarterly revenue from 56% a year earlier.
Shipments of thermocompression bonders for advanced packaging are expected to more than double in fiscal 2027.
The new Singapore production floor started in Q1 and can support close to $500m a year of advanced-solutions revenue.
Management is confident about first-half demand but has limited visibility into the second half; memory sales dipped in the quarter.
call.source: Coverage of the results presentation: Investing.com (19 Nov 2026) and Panabee (18 Nov 2026); no prepared remarks filed

watch: Whether demand holds in the second half of fiscal 2027, where management has limited visibility.
Progress toward the $150-200m Advanced Solutions revenue goal as the Singapore floor ramps.
Cash conversion, after receivables and inventory rose sharply this year.
